Ref. No. PURCM /2026/ 3327 Dated: 27.01.2026
Appointment of one Security Guard on daily wages on current
D.C. rate against vacant post of Security Guard
Applications are invited for the position of one Security Guard on daily wages at the current
D.C. rate for a vacant post of Security Guard at PURC Sri Muktsar Sahib.
Interviews will be held of those candidates who will submit properly completed application
forms in response to the aforementioned advertisement notice. The last date of submitting
application in the office of the Director PURC Sri Muktsar Sahib is 09.02.2026 (5 PM). The
application form is available on the Panjab University Website at
https://forms.puchd.ac.in/forms/class-c-NT-position.pdf?124810171424. The application
form must be completed properly.
The salary and qualification for the post will be as per the D.C. rate of Panjab University
Chandigarh.
The policies of Panjab University Chandigarh will apply to the appointment of this post.
Last date of submitting Application: 09.02.2026
The schedule of interviews will be as follows:
Interview Date No. of Posts Time Venue
12.02.2026 01 11:00 AM to
1:00 PM
PURC, Sri Muktsar Sahib
The candidates should bring all their original certificates and other relevant documents along
with the attested copies of all the certificates/documents (Two copies of each document) and
two passport size photographs.
Note: No TA/DA will be paid for the interview.
Director
